# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking Changes

- **User name field split:** The `name` field on `/v2/users` has been replaced with separate `first_name` and `last_name` fields. Clients that read or write the `name` field must update to use the new fields. There is no automatic migration — existing integrations will need to handle the split at the application level.

## New Features

- **Incremental syncs:** The new `--incremental` flag enables delta-based transfers, syncing only rows that have changed since the last run. This significantly reduces transfer times and resource usage for large, append-heavy tables.

## Performance

- **Parquet writes are 40% faster.** Internal buffering and encoding improvements cut write times across all supported Parquet compression modes. No configuration changes are required — the speedup applies automatically on upgrade.
